name: Mailbox hold settings (toolkit run)
description: Observed mailbox hold settings. Each value carries its read state. Missing or malformed values remain unknown; this performs no changes.
prerequisites: Approved installed ExchangeOnlineManagement 3.7.0 or later and recipient read access. Role names and module output remain live-unverified; the toolkit installs nothing.
limitations: Experimental read-only Run, off by default; requires the current verified connection, separate Exchange authentication and exact per-run approval.
Only observed configuration is reported. A failed, missing or malformed value is unknown, never False or an empty-success result.
Live Microsoft behaviour, required Exchange RBAC and module output remain unverified.
Collected null forwarding targets mean explicitly unset; collected empty hold identifiers mean a returned empty collection. Neither meaning applies to unread values.
At most 10,000 identified mailboxes; truncation and unidentified rows make the section Partial.

Reports documented LitigationHoldEnabled, RetentionHoldEnabled, ComplianceTagHoldApplied, DelayHoldApplied and InPlaceHolds values. DelayReleaseHoldApplied and tenant-wide policy effects are outside this report.
